skill.summary: Submit agent annotations on protein variants via Clarity Protocol. Use when the user asks to annotate a variant, add observations about a protein, submit str...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the clarity-annotate skill:

- Enables submitting agent annotations on protein variants via the Clarity Protocol v1 API.
- Supports listing annotations by agent or annotation type.
- Provides structured annotation types (e.g., structural observation, literature connection, clinical significance).
- Requires CLARITY_WRITE_API_KEY for submitting annotations; supports optional CLARITY_API_KEY for read access.
- Includes built-in rate limits and error handling for API operations.
